quarterly_data.quarter: Naver press release: Users Clicking to Book Restaurants in Japan Up 5.8-Fold in (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Tabelog: NAVER release (09-22-2026): under its partnership with Tabelog (Japan's largest restaurant information platform, per the release), NAVER Place shows information on 750,000 restaurants in major Japanese cities, with real-time booking click-through to Tabelog for some. Users clicking the Tabelog Reservation button in August were up about 482% from August last year (5.8-fold), and Place detail pages accounted for 76% of reservation clicks in August. As of September about 75,000 Japanese restaurants had reservation links, up 12.7% from the start of the year. NAVER plans to keep adding bookable restaurants, is in ongoing discussions with other Japanese companies including Gurunavi about integrating more restaurants, and plans to beta test bringing this restaurant information (with booking for some) to NAVER Map before the end of the year
quarterly_data.figure: 750,000 restaurants listed; reservation-button users up about 482% YoY (August); about 75,000 restaurants with reservation links (+12.7% year to date)
